During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' occurred above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] when Imperial forces attacked the prototype "[[Gilded Meteor]]" [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] on its maiden voyage. Republic forces successfully defended the [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] with the aid of the [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron.<ref name="TOR" />

==The battle==
Escorted by a pair of [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]], the ''Gilded Meteor'' was on its maiden voyage when the group of republic ships was ambushed by a trio of [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]]. The Coruscant Aegis arrived moments later, strafing and heavily damaging the Imperial destroyers whilst protecting the prototype bomber. The Empire subsequently arrived in full force when a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]], escorted by two additional destroyers, joined the battle. Despite their superior numbers, the Imperial forces were unable to destroy the ''Gilded Meteor'' before it escaped to hyperspace. Republic reinforcements consisting of two more Thranta corvettes flanked the Imperial fleet and, together with the Coruscant Aegis, inflicted heavy damage. Despite destroying at least four destroyers and the majority of the Imperial fighters as well as all three [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptors]], the Republic fleet opted for a safe retreat, jumping to hyperspace before taking heavy losses themselves.
